# Bramblewood Outfitters - handheld stock count

stocktake_2026-09-15.csv is the Tuesday count downloaded from the handheld
scanners at the Trellis Park store.

Columns: sku, item, on_hand, safety_stock. on_hand is the number of units
counted on the shelf; safety_stock is the shelf minimum the buying desk
keeps for that line. A line is short when the units on hand are below its
shelf minimum. Counts are whole units.
